text.en:
Currency Act
(Chapter 69)
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 25th June 2007 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE
DESCRIPTION OF THE 2007 HERITAGE ORCHIDS OF SINGAPORE COINS TO BE ISSUED ON 25TH JUNE 2007

5 Dollars
999 Fine Silver
20.00 g + 0.20 g
38.70 mm + 0.15 mm
2.50 mm + 0.30 mm
Round
Milled and bearing the words “MONETARY AUTHORITY OF SINGAPORE” and lion symbol.
The Singapore Arms in the centre with the year-date “2007” below it and the word “SINGAPORE” in the 4 official languages around the circumference of the coin. The position of the mintmark is at 5 o’clock of the coin.
The coin design features the orchid “Dendrobium Singa Mas” in full colour in the lower-left to upper-right of the coin and the name of the orchid is along the upper circumference. The weight in grams and fineness of the coin are at the lower circumference. The denomination is at the upper-left of the coin.
